```{r}
# Loading the relevant R packages:
library(pacman)
p_load(psych, reshape2, WGCNA, igraph, dplyr, Hmisc, SpiecEasi, magrittr)

```


# Internal network analysis of microorganisms

## SpiecEasi_otu_bac

```{r}
# ----------------- Data Loading and Preprocessing -----------------
otutab = read.table("otutab_bac.txt", header=T, row.names= 1, sep="\t", comment.char = "", stringsAsFactors = F)
design = read.table("metadata_bac.tsv", header=T, row.names= 1, sep="\t", comment.char = "", stringsAsFactors = F) 
design$group=design[,"Group"]
# =========================================================================
print(paste("Number of original OTUs: ", nrow(otutab)))

# Retain bacteria that appear in at least 10% of the total samples
prevalence_threshold <- 0.1 * ncol(otutab)
otu_presence <- rowSums(otutab > 0)
keep_prev <- names(otu_presence[otu_presence >= prevalence_threshold])
otutab_step1 <- otutab[keep_prev, ]

# Convert to relative abundance, keeping average relative abundance ≥ 0.01%
otu_relative <- apply(otutab_step1, 2, function(x) x / sum(x))
mean_abundance <- rowMeans(otu_relative)
abundance_threshold <- 0.0001
keep_final <- names(mean_abundance[mean_abundance >= abundance_threshold])

# Obtain the final filtered total bacterial table (recommended remaining 100-300 OTUs as optimal)
otutab_filtered <- otutab_step1[keep_final, ]
print(paste("Number of OTUs used for network analysis after filtering: ", nrow(otutab_filtered)))
# =========================================================================

norm = t(otutab_filtered)
merge = cbind(norm, design[, c("group"), drop=F])


otutab_BQ1 <- t(select(filter(merge, group == "BQ1"),-group))
otutab_BQ2 <- t(select(filter(merge, group == "BQ2"),-group))
otutab_BQ3 <- t(select(filter(merge, group == "BQ3"),-group))
otutab_BQ4 <- t(select(filter(merge, group == "BQ4"),-group))
otutab_BQ5 <- t(select(filter(merge, group == "BQ5"),-group))
otutab_BQ6 <- t(select(filter(merge, group == "BQ6"),-group))

split_otu_bac <- list(BQ1=as.data.frame(otutab_BQ1),
                      BQ2=as.data.frame(otutab_BQ2),
                      BQ3=as.data.frame(otutab_BQ3),
                      BQ4=as.data.frame(otutab_BQ4),
                      BQ5=as.data.frame(otutab_BQ5),
                      BQ6=as.data.frame(otutab_BQ6))

col_g <- "#C1C1C1"
cols <- c("#DEB99B" ,"#5ECC6D", "#5DAFD9", "#7ED1E4", "#EA9527", "#F16E1D" ,"#6E4821", "#A4B423",
          "#C094DF" ,"#DC95D8" ,"#326530", "#50C0C9", "#67C021" ,"#DC69AF", "#8C384F", "#30455C", "#F96C72","#5ED2BF")

# ----------------- SPIEC-EASI network inference -----------------
n_cores <- 8
igraph <- lapply(names(split_otu_bac), function(grp_name){
    print(paste("Running SPIEC-EASI for group:", grp_name))
    x <- split_otu_bac[[grp_name]]
    
    # SPIEC-EASI requires the input: samples as rows, OTUs as columns.
    se.out <- spiec.easi(t(x), 
                         method = 'mb', 
                         lambda.min.ratio = 1e-2,
                         nlambda = 50, 
                         pulsar.params = list(
                             rep.num = 100,
                             ncores = n_cores,
                             thresh = 0.05
                         ))    
    # Get network adjacency matrix
    adj_mat <- getRefit(se.out)
    # Obtain the matrix of partial correlation coefficients
    beta_mat <- as.matrix(getOptBeta(se.out))
    
    rownames(adj_mat) <- colnames(adj_mat) <- rownames(x)
    rownames(beta_mat) <- colnames(beta_mat) <- rownames(x)
    
    # Constructing an igraph Object
    ig <- adj2igraph(adj_mat, vertex.attr=list(name=rownames(x)))
    ig <- simplify(ig)

    # --- Map partial correlation coefficients to the edge weight attribute ---
    edges <- as_edgelist(ig)
    if(nrow(edges) > 0) {
        E(ig)$weight <- apply(edges, 1, function(e) beta_mat[e[1], e[2]])
    }

    
    # Get the absolute weights of all edges
    edge_abs_weights <- abs(E(ig)$weight)
    
    # Filtering: remove edges with small absolute partial correlation coefficients
    # Start with a threshold of 0.1. If the network is still too dense, increase it to 0.15 or 0.2.
    threshold <- 0.22
    edges_to_remove <- E(ig)[edge_abs_weights < threshold]
    ig <- delete_edges(ig, edges_to_remove)
    ig <- delete_vertices(ig, which(degree(ig)==0))

})
names(igraph) <- names(split_otu_bac)
# save(igraph, file = 'network_SpiecEasi_otu_bac.rda')
# load('network_SpiecEasi_otu_bac.rda')

# ----------------- Visualization -----------------
pdf("network_SpiecEasi_otu_bac.pdf", width=15, height=9)
par(mfrow=c(1,6), mar=c(0,0,1,0), font.main=4)
for(i in 1:6){
  g1 <- igraph[[i]]
  
  # The SPIEC-EASI weight is a partial correlation coefficient and can be positive or negative
  E(g1)$correlation <- E(g1)$weight 
  E(g1)$weight <- abs(E(g1)$weight)
  
  set.seed(007)
  V(g1)$modularity <- membership(cluster_fast_greedy(g1))
  V(g1)$label <- V(g1)$name
  V(g1)$label <- NA
  
  modu_sort <- V(g1)$modularity %>% table() %>% sort(decreasing = T)
  # If fewer than 18 modules are generated
  top_num <- min(18, length(modu_sort)) 
  modu_name <- names(modu_sort[1:top_num])
  
  modu_cols <- cols[1:length(modu_name)]
  names(modu_cols) <- modu_name
  
  V(g1)$color <- V(g1)$modularity
  V(g1)$color[!(V(g1)$color %in% modu_name)] <- col_g
  V(g1)$color[(V(g1)$color %in% modu_name)] <- modu_cols[match(V(g1)$color[(V(g1)$color %in% modu_name)], modu_name)]
  V(g1)$frame.color <- V(g1)$color

  E(g1)$color <- col_g
  edgelist_df <- data.frame(as_edgelist(g1))
  for (m in modu_name){
    col_edge <- cols[which(modu_name==m)]
    otu_same_modu <- V(g1)$name[which(V(g1)$modularity==m)]
    E(g1)$color[(edgelist_df$X1 %in% otu_same_modu) & (edgelist_df$X2 %in% otu_same_modu)] <- col_edge
  }

# Extract and clean weight data
w <- abs(E(g1)$weight)

# Handle very small or zero values: the FR algorithm does not allow zero weights
# Replace all zero or NA weights with a very small positive value (1e-6)
w[w <= 0 | is.na(w)] <- 1e-6

  sub_net_layout <- layout_with_fr(g1, niter=999, weights = w, grid = 'nogrid')
  plot(g1, layout=sub_net_layout, edge.color = E(g1)$color, vertex.size=2)
  title(main = paste0(names(split_otu_bac)[i], '\nNodes=', length(V(g1)$name), ', Edges=', nrow(edgelist_df)))
}
dev.off()

# ----------------- Calculate network topological properties -----------------
for(i in 1:6){
  if(vcount(igraph[[i]]) == 0) {
      print(paste("Network", names(split_otu_bac)[i], "is empty."))
      next
  }
  
  curr_g <- igraph[[i]]
  
  # Topological properties (such as path length) are usually calculated using an unweighted graph or physical distances.
  num.vertices = length(V(curr_g))
  num.edges = length(E(curr_g))
  connectance = edge_density(curr_g, loops=FALSE)
  average.degree = mean(degree(curr_g))
  
  # Set weights = NA to calculate the unweighted average path length and avoid errors caused by negative weights
  average.path.length = mean_distance(curr_g, directed = FALSE, weights = NA)
  
  edge.connectivity = edge_connectivity(curr_g)
  clustering.coefficient = transitivity(curr_g) 
  no.clusters = count_components(curr_g) 
  
  centralization.betweenness = centralization.betweenness(curr_g)$centralization 
  centralization.degree = centralization.degree(curr_g)$centralization
  
  a <- cbind(num.vertices, num.edges, connectance, average.degree, 
             average.path.length, edge.connectivity, clustering.coefficient, 
             no.clusters, centralization.betweenness, centralization.degree)
  
  a_df <- as.data.frame(a)
  rownames(a_df) <- names(split_otu_bac)[i]
  write.table(t(a_df), file=paste0("network_property_SpiecEasi_otu_bac_", names(split_otu_bac)[i], ".txt"), 
              quote = F, sep = "\t", col.names = FALSE)
}

```

```{r}

design$group=design[,"Group"]

# =========================================================================
print(paste("Number of original OTUs: ", nrow(otutab)))

# Retain taxa present in at least 10% of all samples
prevalence_threshold <- 0.1 * ncol(otutab)
otu_presence <- rowSums(otutab > 0)
keep_prev <- names(otu_presence[otu_presence >= prevalence_threshold])
otutab_step1 <- otutab[keep_prev, ]

# Convert to relative abundance and retain core taxa with mean relative abundance >= 0.01% (0.0001)
otu_relative <- apply(otutab_step1, 2, function(x) x / sum(x))
mean_abundance <- rowMeans(otu_relative)
abundance_threshold <- 0.0001
keep_final <- names(mean_abundance[mean_abundance >= abundance_threshold])

# Obtain the final filtered abundance table
otutab_filtered <- otutab_step1[keep_final, ]
print(paste("Number of OTUs used for network analysis after filtering: ", nrow(otutab_filtered)))
# =========================================================================

norm = t(otutab_filtered)
merge = cbind(norm, design[, c("group"), drop=F])

otutab_FQ1 <- t(select(filter(merge, group == "FQ1"),-group))
otutab_FQ2 <- t(select(filter(merge, group == "FQ2"),-group))
otutab_FQ3 <- t(select(filter(merge, group == "FQ3"),-group))
otutab_FQ4 <- t(select(filter(merge, group == "FQ4"),-group))
otutab_FQ5 <- t(select(filter(merge, group == "FQ5"),-group))
otutab_FQ6 <- t(select(filter(merge, group == "FQ6"),-group))

split_otu_fun <- list(FQ1=as.data.frame(otutab_FQ1),
                      FQ2=as.data.frame(otutab_FQ2),
                      FQ3=as.data.frame(otutab_FQ3),
                      FQ4=as.data.frame(otutab_FQ4),
                      FQ5=as.data.frame(otutab_FQ5),
                      FQ6=as.data.frame(otutab_FQ6))

col_g <- "#C1C1C1"
cols <- c("#DEB99B" ,"#5ECC6D", "#5DAFD9", "#7ED1E4", "#EA9527", "#F16E1D" ,"#6E4821", "#A4B423",
          "#C094DF" ,"#DC95D8" ,"#326530", "#50C0C9", "#67C021" ,"#DC69AF", "#8C384F", "#30455C", "#F96C72","#5ED2BF")

# ----------------- SPIEC-EASI network inference -----------------
n_cores <- 8
igraph <- lapply(names(split_otu_fun), function(grp_name){
    print(paste("Running SPIEC-EASI for group:", grp_name))
    x <- split_otu_fun[[grp_name]]
    
    # SPIEC-EASI requires samples as rows and OTUs as columns.
    se.out <- spiec.easi(t(x), 
                         method = 'mb', 
                         lambda.min.ratio = 1e-3,
                         nlambda = 50, 
                         pulsar.params = list(
                             rep.num = 100,
                             ncores = n_cores,
                             thresh = 0.1
                         ))    
    # Get the network adjacency matrix
    adj_mat <- getRefit(se.out)
    # Get the partial correlation coefficient matrix
    beta_mat <- as.matrix(getOptBeta(se.out))
    
    # Assign row and column names
    rownames(adj_mat) <- colnames(adj_mat) <- rownames(x)
    rownames(beta_mat) <- colnames(beta_mat) <- rownames(x)
    
    # Construct an igraph object
    ig <- adj2igraph(adj_mat, vertex.attr=list(name=rownames(x)))
    
    # Simplify the network
    ig <- simplify(ig)

    # --- Map partial correlation coefficients to the edge weight attribute ---
    edges <- as_edgelist(ig)
    if(nrow(edges) > 0) {
        E(ig)$weight <- apply(edges, 1, function(e) beta_mat[e[1], e[2]])
    }

    # Get the absolute weights of all edges
    edge_abs_weights <- abs(E(ig)$weight)
    
    # Filtering: remove edges with small absolute partial correlation coefficients
    threshold <- 0.1
    edges_to_remove <- E(ig)[edge_abs_weights < threshold]
    ig <- delete_edges(ig, edges_to_remove)
    ig <- delete.vertices(ig, which(degree(ig)==0))

})
names(igraph) <- names(split_otu_fun)

  V(g1)$color[(V(g1)$color %in% modu_name)] <- modu_cols[match(V(g1)$color[(V(g1)$color %in% modu_name)], modu_name)]
  V(g1)$frame.color <- V(g1)$color
```

## SpiecEasi_otu_bac_lable
```{r}
otutab = read.table("otutab_bac.txt", header=T, row.names= 1, sep="\t", comment.char = "", stringsAsFactors = F)
design = read.table("metadata_bac.tsv", header=T, row.names= 1, sep="\t", comment.char = "", stringsAsFactors = F) 
design$group=design[,"igraph"]
taxonomy = read.table("taxonomy_bac.txt", header=T, row.names= 1, sep="\t", comment.char = "", stringsAsFactors = F)

# Data filtering
print(paste("Number of original OTUs: ", nrow(otutab)))

prevalence_threshold <- 0.1 * ncol(otutab)
otu_presence <- rowSums(otutab > 0)
keep_prev <- names(otu_presence[otu_presence >= prevalence_threshold])
otutab_step1 <- otutab[keep_prev, ]

otu_relative <- apply(otutab_step1, 2, function(x) x / sum(x))
mean_abundance <- rowMeans(otu_relative)
abundance_threshold <- 0.0001
keep_final <- names(mean_abundance[mean_abundance >= abundance_threshold])

otutab_filtered <- otutab_step1[keep_final, ]
print(paste("Number of OTUs used for network analysis after filtering: ", nrow(otutab_filtered)))
# =========================================================================

norm = t(otutab_filtered)
merge = cbind(norm, design[, c("group"), drop=F])

otutab_igraph0 <- t(select(filter(merge, group == "igraph0"),-group))

split_otu_bac <- list(igraph0=as.data.frame(otutab_igraph0))

col_g <- "#C1C1C1"
cols <- c("#DEB99B" ,"#5ECC6D", "#5DAFD9", "#7ED1E4", "#EA9527", "#F16E1D" ,"#6E4821", "#A4B423",
          "#C094DF" ,"#DC95D8" ,"#326530", "#50C0C9", "#67C021" ,"#DC69AF", "#8C384F", "#30455C", "#F96C72","#5ED2BF")

# ----------------- SPIEC-EASI network inference -----------------
n_cores <- 8
igraph <- lapply(names(split_otu_bac), function(grp_name){
    print(paste("Running SPIEC-EASI for group:", grp_name))
    x <- split_otu_bac[[grp_name]]
    
    se.out <- spiec.easi(t(x), 
                         method = 'mb', 
                         lambda.min.ratio = 1e-2,
                         nlambda = 50, 
                         pulsar.params = list(
                             rep.num = 100,       
                             ncores = n_cores,
                             thresh = 0.05       
                         ))    
    adj_mat <- getRefit(se.out)
    beta_mat <- as.matrix(getOptBeta(se.out))
    
    rownames(adj_mat) <- colnames(adj_mat) <- rownames(x)
    rownames(beta_mat) <- colnames(beta_mat) <- rownames(x)
    
    ig <- adj2igraph(adj_mat, vertex.attr=list(name=rownames(x)))
    ig <- simplify(ig)

    edges <- as_edgelist(ig)
    if(nrow(edges) > 0) {
        E(ig)$weight <- apply(edges, 1, function(e) beta_mat[e[1], e[2]])
    }

    edge_abs_weights <- abs(E(ig)$weight)
    threshold <- 0.1
    edges_to_remove <- E(ig)[edge_abs_weights < threshold]
    ig <- delete_edges(ig, edges_to_remove)

    ig <- delete.vertices(ig, which(degree(ig)==0))
})
names(igraph) <- names(split_otu_bac)
# save(igraph, file = 'network_SpiecEasi_otu_bac_lable.rda')
# load('network_SpiecEasi_otu_bac_lable.rda')

# ----------------- Visualization and attribute export -----------------
pdf("network_SpiecEasi_otu_bac_lable.pdf", width=15, height=9)
par(mfrow=c(1,1), mar=c(1,1,2,1), font.main=4) 
for(i in 1:1){
  g1 <- igraph[[i]]
  
  E(g1)$correlation <- E(g1)$weight 
  E(g1)$weight <- abs(E(g1)$weight)
  
  set.seed(007)
  V(g1)$modularity <- as.numeric(membership(cluster_fast_greedy(g1))) 
  
  # Use taxonomic annotations as labels
  V(g1)$label <- taxonomy[V(g1)$name, "Genus"]
  
  deg <- degree(g1)
  V(g1)$label[deg < 6] <- NA  
  V(g1)$label[V(g1)$label == "Unassigned"] <- NA
  
  # Calculate module colors
  modu_sort <- V(g1)$modularity %>% table() %>% sort(decreasing = T)
  top_num <- min(18, length(modu_sort)) 
  modu_name <- names(modu_sort[1:top_num])
  
  modu_cols <- cols[1:length(modu_name)]
  names(modu_cols) <- modu_name
  
  V(g1)$color <- V(g1)$modularity
  V(g1)$color[!(V(g1)$color %in% modu_name)] <- col_g
  V(g1)$color[(V(g1)$color %in% modu_name)] <- modu_cols[match(V(g1)$color[(V(g1)$color %in% modu_name)], modu_name)]
  V(g1)$frame.color <- V(g1)$color

  # Match label colors to module/node colors
  V(g1)$label.color <- adjustcolor(V(g1)$color, offset = c(-0.2, -0.2, -0.2, 0))

  E(g1)$color <- adjustcolor(col_g, alpha.f = 0.3)
  edgelist_df <- data.frame(as_edgelist(g1))
  for (m in modu_name){
    col_edge <- adjustcolor(cols[which(modu_name==m)], alpha.f = 0.3) 
    otu_same_modu <- V(g1)$name[which(V(g1)$modularity==m)]
    E(g1)$color[(edgelist_df$X1 %in% otu_same_modu) & (edgelist_df$X2 %in% otu_same_modu)] <- col_edge
  }

  w <- abs(E(g1)$weight)
  w[w <= 0 | is.na(w)] <- 1e-6

  # Assign dynamic node sizes
  V(g1)$size <- 0.05 + (degree(g1) * 1)

  sub_net_layout <- layout_with_fr(g1, niter=999, weights = w, grid = 'nogrid')
  
  # Plotting
  plot(g1, 
       layout=sub_net_layout, 
       edge.color = E(g1)$color, 
       vertex.size = V(g1)$size,
       vertex.label.cex=1,       
       vertex.label.color = V(g1)$label.color,
       vertex.label.dist=0.5,        
       vertex.label.font=0.2)        
  
  title(main = paste0(names(split_otu_fun)[i], '\nNodes=', length(V(g1)$name), ', Edges=', nrow(edgelist_df)))
  
  
  # Export the node attribute table
  node_attr <- data.frame(
    Node_ID     = V(g1)$name,
    Degree      = degree(g1),
    Node_Size   = V(g1)$size,        
    Modularity  = V(g1)$modularity,
    Color       = V(g1)$color,
    Label_Color = V(g1)$label.color,  
    Label_Genus = ifelse(is.na(V(g1)$label), "NA", V(g1)$label),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  node_taxonomy <- taxonomy[node_attr$Node_ID, , drop = FALSE]
  node_attr <- cbind(node_attr, node_taxonomy)
  
  write.table(node_attr, 
              file = paste0("network_node_SpiecEasi_otu_bac_lable_", names(split_otu_fun)[i], ".txt"), 
              quote = FALSE, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE)
  
  # =========================================================================
  # Export the edge attribute table
  # =========================================================================
  edge_edges <- as_edgelist(g1)
  if (nrow(edge_edges) > 0) {
    edge_attr <- data.frame(
      Source      = edge_edges[, 1],
      Target      = edge_edges[, 2],
      Weight      = E(g1)$weight,
      Correlation = E(g1)$correlation,

    )

  }
}
```

```{r}
otutab = read.table("otutab_fun.txt", header=T, row.names= 1, sep="\t", comment.char = "", stringsAsFactors = F)
design = read.table("metadata_fun.tsv", header=T, row.names= 1, sep="\t", comment.char = "", stringsAsFactors = F) 
design$group=design[,"igraph"]
taxonomy = read.table("taxonomy_fun.txt", header=T, row.names= 1, sep="\t", comment.char = "", stringsAsFactors = F)

prevalence_threshold <- 0.1 * ncol(otutab)
otu_presence <- rowSums(otutab > 0)
keep_prev <- names(otu_presence[otu_presence >= prevalence_threshold])
otutab_step1 <- otutab[keep_prev, ]

otu_relative <- apply(otutab_step1, 2, function(x) x / sum(x))
mean_abundance <- rowMeans(otu_relative)
abundance_threshold <- 0.0001
keep_final <- names(mean_abundance[mean_abundance >= abundance_threshold])

otutab_filtered <- otutab_step1[keep_final, ]
print(paste("Number of OTUs used for network analysis after filtering: ", nrow(otutab_filtered)))
# =========================================================================

norm = t(otutab_filtered)
merge = cbind(norm, design[, c("group"), drop=F])

otutab_igraph0 <- t(select(filter(merge, group == "igraph0"),-group))

split_otu_fun <- list(igraph0=as.data.frame(otutab_igraph0))

col_g <- "#C1C1C1"
cols <- c("#DEB99B" ,"#5ECC6D", "#5DAFD9", "#7ED1E4", "#EA9527", "#F16E1D" ,"#6E4821", "#A4B423",
          "#C094DF" ,"#DC95D8" ,"#326530", "#50C0C9", "#67C021" ,"#DC69AF", "#8C384F", "#30455C", "#F96C72","#5ED2BF")

# ----------------- SPIEC-EASI network inference -----------------
n_cores <- 6
igraph <- lapply(names(split_otu_fun), function(grp_name){
    print(paste("Running SPIEC-EASI for group:", grp_name))
    x <- split_otu_fun[[grp_name]]
    
    se.out <- spiec.easi(t(x), 
                         method = 'mb', 
                         lambda.min.ratio = 1e-2,
                         nlambda = 50, 
                         pulsar.params = list(
                             rep.num = 100,       
                             ncores = n_cores,
                             thresh = 0.05       
                         ))    
    adj_mat <- getRefit(se.out)
    beta_mat <- as.matrix(getOptBeta(se.out))
    
    rownames(adj_mat) <- colnames(adj_mat) <- rownames(x)
    rownames(beta_mat) <- colnames(beta_mat) <- rownames(x)
    
    ig <- adj2igraph(adj_mat, vertex.attr=list(name=rownames(x)))
    ig <- simplify(ig)

    edges <- as_edgelist(ig)
    if(nrow(edges) > 0) {
        E(ig)$weight <- apply(edges, 1, function(e) beta_mat[e[1], e[2]])
    }

    edge_abs_weights <- abs(E(ig)$weight)
    threshold <- 0.1
    edges_to_remove <- E(ig)[edge_abs_weights < threshold]
    ig <- delete_edges(ig, edges_to_remove)

    ig <- delete.vertices(ig, which(degree(ig)==0))
})
names(igraph) <- names(split_otu_fun)

for(i in 1:1){
  g1 <- igraph[[i]]
  
  E(g1)$correlation <- E(g1)$weight 
  E(g1)$weight <- abs(E(g1)$weight)
  
  set.seed(007)
  V(g1)$modularity <- as.numeric(membership(cluster_fast_greedy(g1))) 
  
  V(g1)$label <- taxonomy[V(g1)$name, "Genus"]
  
  deg <- degree(g1)
  V(g1)$label[deg < 2] <- NA  
  V(g1)$label[V(g1)$label == "Unassigned"] <- NA

    modu_sort <- V(g1)$modularity %>% table() %>% sort(decreasing = T)
  top_num <- min(18, length(modu_sort)) 
  modu_name <- names(modu_sort[1:top_num])
  
  modu_cols <- cols[1:length(modu_name)]
  names(modu_cols) <- modu_name
  
  V(g1)$color <- V(g1)$modularity
  V(g1)$color[!(V(g1)$color %in% modu_name)] <- col_g
  V(g1)$color[(V(g1)$color %in% modu_name)] <- modu_cols[match(V(g1)$color[(V(g1)$color %in% modu_name)], modu_name)]
  V(g1)$frame.color <- V(g1)$color

  V(g1)$label.color <- adjustcolor(V(g1)$color, offset = c(-0.2, -0.2, -0.2, 0))

  E(g1)$color <- adjustcolor(col_g, alpha.f = 0.3) 
  edgelist_df <- data.frame(as_edgelist(g1))
  for (m in modu_name){
    col_edge <- adjustcolor(cols[which(modu_name==m)], alpha.f = 0.3)
    otu_same_modu <- V(g1)$name[which(V(g1)$modularity==m)]
    E(g1)$color[(edgelist_df$X1 %in% otu_same_modu) & (edgelist_df$X2 %in% otu_same_modu)] <- col_edge
  }

  w <- abs(E(g1)$weight)
  w[w <= 0 | is.na(w)] <- 1e-6

  V(g1)$size <- 0.05 + (degree(g1) * 2)

  sub_net_layout <- layout_with_fr(g1, niter=999, weights = w, grid = 'nogrid')
  
  # Plotting
  plot(g1, 
       layout=sub_net_layout, 
       edge.color = E(g1)$color, 
       vertex.size = V(g1)$size,
       vertex.label.cex=1,       
       vertex.label.color = V(g1)$label.color,
       vertex.label.dist=0.5,        
       vertex.label.font=0.2)        
  
  title(main = paste0(names(split_otu_fun)[i], '\nNodes=', length(V(g1)$name), ', Edges=', nrow(edgelist_df)))
  
  node_attr <- data.frame(

    Modularity  = V(g1)$modularity,
    Color       = V(g1)$color,
    Label_Color = V(g1)$label.color,  
    Label_Genus = ifelse(is.na(V(g1)$label), "NA", V(g1)$label),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  node_taxonomy <- taxonomy[node_attr$Node_ID, , drop = FALSE]
  node_attr <- cbind(node_attr, node_taxonomy)
  
  write.table(node_attr, 
              file = paste0("network_node_SpiecEasi_otu_fun_lable_", names(split_otu_fun)[i], ".txt"), 
              quote = FALSE, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE)
  
  edge_edges <- as_edgelist(g1)
  if (nrow(edge_edges) > 0) {
```
